text:
ana: quick q — trying to pull raw log lines that contain a specific request_id (edge request-ref) to see where the 502 happened. what's the fastest path: console link -> ? or do i just stern/grep across pods?

sam: If you have the request_id, start at the trace in Console. Open the trace and expand spans — the span's resource attr usually has pod/host. The trace UI has 'view logs' link for each span.

teju: If console link is missing, use `redwoodctl traces get <trace_id> --json` to list spans and service names. Then grep logs in those pods.

michael: Short cheat: if you know the x-request-id header value (req-abc123), try:
```
# find pod(s) that handled it (k8s)
kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | awk '{print $1}'
stern -n prod --since 1h --tail 1000 "" | grep req-abc123
```
This works but noisy — use `stern <pod-selector>` if you can narrow.

sam: Also try the cross-service index in Loki (console logs):
```
{app=\"edge\"} |= \"req-abc123\" or {app=\"backend\"} |= \"req-abc123\"
```
That finds both edge and backend lines and shows timestamps so you can correlate.

ana: i only have a trace id: 0af3c1b2. how to map trace -> request_id?

teju: redwoodctl again:
```
redwoodctl traces get 0af3c1b2 --format json | jq -r '.spans[] | select(.tags|contains("x-request-id")) | .tags["x-request-id"]'
```
If traces don't include header tags, look for span.log message fields mentioning the header.

infra-bot: Note: sampled traces may not include the header. If missing, try edge ingress logs; ingress typically logs x-request-ref mapping.

michael: if you want a one-liner to hunt across pods by trace id -> timestamps -> lines:
```
# get timestamp from trace
ts=$(redwoodctl traces get 0af3c1b2 --json | jq -r '.startTime')
# then search logs +/- 5s
stern -n prod --since 10s --timestamps | grep "2026-03-10T" | grep "0af3c1b2\\|req-"
```

ana: perfect — this helped. pinned the console trace link here: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/0af3c1b2

sam: also add `X-Request-Ref` to debug logs if you need per-tenant traceability; open a quick PR and tag @teju for review :thumbsup:

teju: happy to review, small note — don't log PII, only request id.

ana: thanks all :rocket:
